structs.name: WalkVertex
structs.comment: A vertex of the walk-sector vertex pool (WalkPlane.cpp's vertex database, 0x400 records at 0x008cb0b0). WalkPlane_AddVertex welds a new vertex to an existing one closer than 1e-4 and counts the reference, so neighbouring sectors share their corner vertices (ShrinkBoxes moves them together).
fields: sectors that use the vertex (WalkPlane_AddVertex / WalkPlane_RemoveVertex); 0 = the record is free

structs.name: WalkPlane
structs.comment: A sector of the set file (WalkPlane.cpp's WalkPlane, 0x84 bytes, made by ParseCollection): a planar polygon of up to 10 vertices with a type and two activity flags. All sectors of the loaded set are on the list g_pWalkPlane_wp_head, the newest first.
fields: type bits (WalkPlane_SetType): 0x1000 walk, 0x1100 funnel (a 4-vertex walk sector, see nLongEdge), 0x2000 camera, 0x4000 special, 0x8000 chernobyl
the set file's default visibility; ShrinkBoxes clears it for a sector it cannot shrink, WalkPlane_RestoreCache restores it
1 at load and after WalkPlane_AllActive; Lua MakeSectorActive; Planner_SharedSector clears it while it searches
how far a point may be off the plane and still be inside (WalkPlane_Within): 0.005 for walk sectors, else the file's height (9999 by WalkPlane_SetType)
the polygon, records of the vertex pool
the edge WalkPlane_Intersection last crossed (its first vertex), -1 none; WalkPlane_JumpOut and WalkPlane_GetConstraintVector step it
funnel sectors (0x100): the first vertex of the long edge, 0 to 3 (WalkPlane_SetType)
first of the two coordinate axes the polygon is projected on for the 2-D tests (the normal's largest component is left out)

structs.name: WalkPlaneCache
structs.comment: One sector as WalkPlane_BuildCache saved it before ShrinkBoxes, g_pWalkPlaneCache[g_nWalkPlaneCacheSize]; WalkPlane_RestoreCache puts it back.
fields: its vertices as indices into the vertex pool

structs.name: WalkVertexCache
structs.comment: One vertex as WalkPlane_BuildCache saved it, g_pVertexCache[g_nVertexCacheSize] (one entry per vertex of every sector).
